sprint_thesis: W13 is launch runway, not new code. The game is shippable today. W13 makes the launch SAFE: docs current, runbook accurate, trailer shot-list ready for Kevin to record, dress-rehearsal proves cold-clone deploy works. After W13 lands -> ~25 days of soak before T-0. Not a content sprint, not a polish sprint, runway only. No src/*.js changes unless P5 dress rehearsal surfaces a launch-blocking bug.

architect_decisions_locked.summary: Codex delivers TRAILER_SHOT_LIST.md only. Kevin records via QuickTime/OBS, assembles in iMovie. Final at ACTIVE/delivery/w14_launch/cehp_launch_trailer_v2.mp4 (Kevin owns). Building Phaser-in-Playwright video capture is 1-2 days of net-new engineering with zero post-launch value.
Author LAUNCH_RUNBOOK_W14.md fresh. Do NOT mutate LAUNCH_RUNBOOK_W6.md (historical, pre-rebuild).
Audit SEND_READY_PACKET.md, mark stale images with [REPLACE: <description>] markers for Kevin to swap manually. Not building a screenshot pipeline.

P5 includes Chrome / Safari / Firefox quick check (whatever is installed). Per launch arc Risk 2: Firefox/Safari regressions = KNOWN_ISSUES.md entry, NOT launch blocker. Chrome stable regression = blocker.
After P5 GREEN, create LAUNCH_FREEZE.md with commit hash + bundle bytes + oracle count + 10 replay md5s + soak-period contract. Tag launch-freeze, push tag.

sacred_constraints_unchanged: Single HTML shipped artifact via node ACTIVE/game/build.js
Phaser 3 via CDN, no npm in play path
Voice rule: deadpan, <=8 words/line, no '!', ALL CAPS for receipt text
Seeded LCG RNG only in sim/state - Date.now allowed only in archival timestamps (04_save.js, 81_docket.js)

phases.title: TRAILER_SHOT_LIST.md
scope: 8-12 takes covering: cold-open title moment, W1 first verb usage, W2 atrium dread, W3 rasta-soft-belt warmth, receipt reveal, docket meta-loop tease
Per take: shot purpose, entry conditions (seed / room / approach), expected duration, 'you'll know it's the take when X'
60px Ed, CRT rim-light visible, 60fps run, deadpan tone (no exclamation marks even in shot descriptions)
phases.acceptance: Kevin can pick takes from list and record without further guidance

phases.title: KNOWN_ISSUES.md + A11Y_STATUS.md refresh
scope: KNOWN_ISSUES: audit against git log since launch arc was written. Close W10-W12-fixed items. Surface unresolved.
KNOWN_ISSUES: add new section 'W12-shipped: known limitations' covering W11_CONTENT_BIAS = 1.1 + deferred mini-bosses/setpieces/parallax (with backlog pointer)
A11Y_STATUS: refresh for current verbs - ground dash 260px/s, double jump 82%, wall-slide + wall-jump, slide/roll with jump-cancel, diagonal aim +/-35 degrees
A11Y_STATUS: forgiveness windows - coyote 100ms, jump buffer 100ms, variable jump cut, corner forgive 6px, ledge snap 8x10px
A11Y_STATUS: audio = procedural Web Audio (W12); 'ambient drone, no music score; events are diegetic hits'
A11Y_STATUS: acknowledge no remappable controls UI in v1 (defer to post-launch)
phases.acceptance: Both docs current as of 5ee7e99; no claim contradicted by code

phases.title: LAUNCH_RUNBOOK_W14.md authored + LAUNCH_INCIDENT_LOG.md template
new_files: ACTIVE/docs/LAUNCH_INCIDENT_LOG.md (template if not exists, refresh otherwise)
scope: Pre-launch checklist (T-1 day): runs P5 dress-rehearsal procedure
Launch sequence (T-0, time-stamped): morning cold-clone gauntlet -> midday final taste-gate (Kevin) -> 5pm CT push to main -> DNS flip -> CR send (if not Monday) -> announce thread -> trailer publish
Per-step verification: command + GREEN-output + RED-mode
Rollback procedures: 3 scenarios (broken link, missing asset, save-corruption) with exact revert commands
Post-launch monitoring: T-0 + T+1h + T+4h + T+24h check-ins
Reference but DO NOT reproduce LAUNCH_RUNBOOK_W6.md
LAUNCH_INCIDENT_LOG.md = empty template Kevin fills during launch day with timestamps + status

Mark stale images with [REPLACE: <description>] for Kevin to swap manually
If directory layout differs from expected, surface and pause

phases.title: Launch dress rehearsal
scope: Codex executes once during P5; this doc IS the T-1 recipe Kevin re-runs Thursday 2026-05-28
Step 1: git clone <origin-or-local> /tmp/cehp-rehearsal-$(date +%s)
Step 2: cd .../ACTIVE/game && npm install
Step 3: node build.js && bash scripts/verify-launch.sh (capture wall-clock)
Step 4: npm run test:replay 3x cold (capture wall-clock per run)
Step 5: open ACTIVE/game/index.html in default browser, W1 entry, confirm: procedural ambient plays, Ed at 60px with CRT rim-light, first receipt fragment fires at end of run
Step 6: cross-browser quick check (whatever's installed) - Chrome / Safari / Firefox. Visible regressions go to KNOWN_ISSUES.md (non-blocker per launch arc unless Chrome stable breaks)
Document each step's actual wall-clock time (not estimates)
phases.acceptance: Rehearsal completes GREEN end-to-end on first try; doc captures actual times

phases.title: Final freeze + git tag
scope: Freeze commit hash (commit immediately after P5 lands)
Bundle bytes, oracle count, all 10 replay md5s (copy from .codex/CEHP/w12_replay_hashes.md + earlier hash docs)
Sacred constraint reaffirmation
Soak period contract: '2026-05-04 -> 2026-05-29. Beyond this point: only launch-blocking-bug fixes go to main.'
Launch-blocking definition: game won't start, save corruption, security issue, Chrome stable broken. Anything else = post-launch.
git tag -a launch-freeze -m 'W13 launch freeze 2026-05-04'
git push origin launch-freeze
phases.acceptance: Freeze doc + tag both on origin/main
